title: Modeling uncertainty in neural networks with TensorFlow Probability: Part 1: An introduction
summary: This paper introduces a tutorial series on modeling uncertainty in neural networks using TensorFlow Probability (TFP). The author motivates the importance of uncertainty estimation through a medical diagnosis example, showing how a model might give high confidence predictions (0.9 softmax score) but have wide confidence intervals when uncertainty is properly modeled, which could dramatically affect clinical decision-making. The paper provides a hands-on introduction to TFP's key components, particularly the `tfp.distributions` module, explaining concepts like batch shapes, event shapes, and basic distribution methods (sample, prob, log_prob) that form the foundation for uncertainty modeling in neural networks.
